<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the signals in the aromatic region (≈110‑160 ppm) are: 143.10, 139.03, 135.88, 129.50 (×2), 129.01 (×2), 128.90 (×2), 128.50 (×2), and 127.20. Counting each occurrence gives 12 aromatic carbon signals, indicating 12 aromatic carbons in the molecule.</thought>
